title: Winter Battery Check 101
caption: Saskatoon’s cold mornings can drain a weak battery fast. Test yours before the temperature drops, and replace if it’s more than four years old. If you’re not sure, our mobile team can swing by your home or workplace and run a quick load test—no need to drive to a shop.
image_prompt: A mechanic in a blue uniform testing a car battery in a frosty Saskatoon driveway, with the city’s iconic Broadway Bridge in the background.

title: Monday Morning Car Feelings
caption: When your car says ‘I need an oil change’ but you’re already late for coffee—*whoops*—don’t worry, we’ll come to you and get you back on the road before your latte goes cold.
image_prompt: A cartoon illustration of a sleepy car with coffee cups floating around, set in a Saskatoon morning scene.

title: The Pothole Survivor
caption: Meet Bella, a trusty Saskatoon sedan that just survived a massive pothole on 8th Street. She’s still running smooth, thanks to a quick undercarriage inspection. Stories like this remind us why a mobile check‑up can catch hidden damage early.
image_prompt: A photo of a sleek sedan parked on a Saskatoon street, with a giant pothole visible nearby and a mechanic inspecting the undercarriage.

title: Check Engine Light: Why Acting Early Matters
caption: A glowing check engine light isn’t just a nuisance—it can signal issues that get worse if ignored. Book a mobile diagnostic with us and we’ll pinpoint the problem right at your location, saving you a potential tow and bigger repair bills later.
image_prompt: A close‑up of a dashboard with a illuminated check engine light, set against a Saskatoon street at dusk.

title: Skip the Tow, Keep Moving
caption: No need to arrange a tow and wait at a shop for hours. Our mobile mechanic arrives at your Saskatoon home, office, or driveway, diagnoses the issue, and gets you back on the road quickly—because your schedule matters.
image_prompt: A mobile mechanic van parked in front of a Saskatoon residence, with the mechanic waving and a car ready to go.
